output.headline: Tariq Aziz's hat-trick sinks Harbour City 3-0
output.text: Southmere United against Harbour City started as a tense, scrappy fight. Early on, Tariq Aziz had a great chance from very close range, but the keeper saved it. Harbour City pushed back and Dani Kowalski tested the keeper too, yet nobody could score before the break. Then, late in the first half, Joel Martin set up Tariq Aziz and he finally smashed in the opener. Soon after the restart, Bruno Costa slipped him another pass and it was 2-0. Late on, Joel Martin won the ball back and Tariq Aziz made it 3-0. Southmere United were sharper in front of goal, and Tariq Aziz was the star.
